_doc: M7 headquarters. Each department has 3 levels: cost (company cash), monthly running cost, and an effect per level. A department level cannot exceed the HQ building tier + 1.

ops.name: Operations Control Centre
ops.room: Ops room with a live wall map of your flights

revenue.name: Revenue Management
revenue.effect: Fare optimiser on the Routes tab; ticket revenue +2% per level

network.name: Network Planning
network.room: Planning room with a route-map table

training.name: Training Centre
training.effect: Staff morale +3% and crew costs −3% per level

pr.name: PR & Communications
pr.effect: Bad news hurts 25% less per level; reputation +1.5 per level

cargo.name: Cargo Division
cargo.effect: Belly cargo fill +8% and freight demand +10% per level

charter.name: Charter & VIP Sales
charter.effect: 40% more charter requests and +10% charter margins per level

ir.name: Investor Relations
ir.effect: Smaller share-price swings (−25% per level) and a better valuation (+3% per level)

legal.name: Legal & Regulatory
legal.effect: Regulators block 30% less often and boards accept bids more readily, per level
